title: DNS Request Failure in Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1.0.89

blocks.text: In Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1.0.89 for Windows, the nslookup command, which targets a DNS request to a specific DNS server by domain, fails on devices running Zscaler Client Connector with only an IPv4 address if the DNS domain is a Private Access application (e.g., *.company.com).
This issue was fixed in Zscaler Client Connector version 4.1.0.98 for Windows.
